newsitem.title: USA: NYPA shuts 825 MW N.Y. power plant for 6-8 weeks.
newsitem.headline: NYPA shuts 825 MW N.Y. power plant for 6-8 weeks.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) shut 825 megawatt (MW) Poletti power station Friday for a six to eight week reserve shutdown, a spokeswoman said late Tuesday.
A utility typically takes a unit off line, especially those that run on expensive fuels such as oil and natural gas, during spring and autumn because of modest electricity demand.
The Poletti plant, in New York City, could return to service within 24 to 48 hours, the NYPA spokeswoman noted.
NYPA generates one fourth of the electricity produced in the state of New York.
